Ruth, I can't set this up as a recurring job. I have no scheduler, so I can't post at 07:45 each morning starting tomorrow. I also can't count on remembering to do it.

What I can do:
- **Post a brief on request.** Mention me in #strategic-random and I'll summarise new messages in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. I'd only read channels you're in, and the membership checks out: everyone in #strategic-random is also in #inc-vtg-hartford, so a combined brief won't reach anyone new.
- **Set up the schedule elsewhere.** Someone with access to the team's scheduler could create a daily job that calls me, or add a recurring calendar reminder for you to ask for the brief each morning.

Tell me which you'd like.
